functionDeclarations.name: list_directory
functionDeclarations.description: Lists the names of files and subdirectories directly within a specified directory path. Can optionally ignore entries matching provided glob patterns.

path.description: The absolute path to the directory to list (must be absolute, not relative)

ignore.description: List of glob patterns to ignore

file_filtering_options.description: Optional: Whether to respect ignore patterns from .gitignore or .geminiignore

respect_git_ignore.description: Optional: Whether to respect .gitignore patterns when listing files. Only available in git repositories. Defaults to true.

respect_gemini_ignore.description: Optional: Whether to respect .geminiignore patterns when listing files. Defaults to true.

functionDeclarations.name: read_file
functionDeclarations.description: Reads and returns the content of a specified file. If the file is large, the content will be truncated. The tool's response will clearly indicate if truncation has occurred and will provide details on how to read more of the file using the 'offset' and 'limit' parameters. Handles text, images (PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP, SVG, BMP), and PDF files. For text files, it can read specific line ranges. For images, videos or other multimedia files, use the 'analyze_multimedia' tool if available.

absolute_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read (e.g., '/home/user/project/file.txt'). Relative paths are not supported. You must provide an absolute path.

offset.description: Optional: For text files, the 0-based line number to start reading from. If provided without 'limit', a default limit of 2000 lines is applied automatically. Negative values are clamped to 0. Use for paginating through large files.

limit.description: Optional: For text files, maximum number of lines to read. Values above 2000 are clamped automatically. Use with 'offset' to paginate through large files. Adjust the limit for large files according to total lines in the file.

functionDeclarations.name: search_file_content
functionDeclarations.description: Searches for a regular expression pattern within the content of files in a specified directory, a specific file, or the current working directory. Can filter files by a glob pattern when searching directories. Returns the lines containing matches, along with their file paths and line numbers.

pattern.description: The regular expression (regex) pattern to search for within file contents (e.g., 'function\s+myFunction', 'import\s+\{.*\}\s+from\s+.*').

path.description: Optional: The absolute path to a directory or file to search within. If a file path is provided, searches only within that file. If a directory path is provided, searches all files in that directory. If omitted, searches the current working directory.

include.description: Optional: A glob pattern to filter which files are searched (e.g., '*.js', '*.{ts,tsx}', 'src/**'). Only applicable when searching directories, ignored for file searches. If omitted, searches all files (respecting potential global ignores).

maxResults.description: Optional: Maximum number of matches to return to prevent context overflow (default: 20, max: 150). Values above 150 are clamped automatically. Use lower values for broad searches, higher for specific searches.

functionDeclarations.name: glob
functionDeclarations.description: Efficiently finds files matching specific glob patterns (e.g., `src/**/*.ts`, `**/*.md`), returning absolute paths sorted by modification time (newest first). Ideal for quickly locating files based on their name or path structure, especially in large codebases.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match against (e.g., '**/*.py', 'docs/*.md').

path.description: Optional: The absolute path to the directory to search within. If omitted, searches the root directory.

case_sensitive.description: Optional: Whether the search should be case-sensitive. Defaults to false.

respect_git_ignore.description: Optional: Whether to respect .gitignore patterns when finding files. Only available in git repositories. Defaults to true.

maxResults.description: Optional: Maximum number of file paths to return (default: 1000). Use to limit output for broad patterns.

functionDeclarations.name: replace
functionDeclarations.description:
Replaces text within a file. By default, replaces a single occurrence, but can replace multiple occurrences when `expected_replacements` is specified. This tool requires providing significant context around the change to ensure precise targeting. Always use the read_file tool to examine the file's current content before attempting a text replacement.

      The user has the ability to modify the `new_string` content. If modified, this will be stated in the response.

Expectation for required parameters:
1. `file_path` MUST be an absolute path; otherwise an error will be thrown.
2. `old_string` MUST be the exact literal text to replace (including all whitespace, indentation, newlines, and surrounding code etc.).
3. `new_string` MUST be the exact literal text to replace `old_string` with (also including all whitespace, indentation, newlines, and surrounding code etc.). Ensure the resulting code is correct and idiomatic.
4. NEVER escape `old_string` or `new_string`, that would break the exact literal text requirement.
**Important:** If ANY of the above are not satisfied, the tool will fail. CRITICAL for `old_string`: Must uniquely identify the single instance to change. Include at least 3 lines of context BEFORE and AFTER the target text, matching whitespace and indentation precisely. If this string matches multiple locations, or does not match exactly, the tool will fail.
**Multiple replacements:** Set `expected_replacements` to the number of occurrences you want to replace. The tool will replace ALL occurrences that match `old_string` exactly. Ensure the number of replacements matches your expectation.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify. Must start with '/'.

old_string.description: The exact literal text to replace, preferably unescaped. For single replacements (default), include at least 3 lines of context BEFORE and AFTER the target text, matching whitespace and indentation precisely. For multiple replacements, specify expected_replacements parameter. If this string is not the exact literal text (i.e. you escaped it) or does not match exactly, the tool will fail.

new_string.description: The exact literal text to replace `old_string` with, preferably unescaped. Provide the EXACT text. Ensure the resulting code is correct and idiomatic.

expected_replacements.description: Number of replacements expected. Defaults to 1 if not specified. Use when you want to replace multiple occurrences.

functionDeclarations.name: write_file
functionDeclarations.description:
Writes content to a specified file in the local filesystem.

      The user has the ability to modify `content`. If modified, this will be stated in the response.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to write to (e.g., '/home/user/project/file.txt'). Relative paths are not supported.

content.description: The content to write to the file.

functionDeclarations.name: web_fetch
functionDeclarations.description: Fetches and processes content from exactly one URL embedded in a prompt. Provide a single 'prompt' that includes exactly one URL and clear instructions (e.g., summarize, extract specific data).

prompt.description: A comprehensive prompt that includes exactly one URL and specific instructions on how to process the fetched content (e.g., "Summarize https://example.com/article"). The URL must be valid and complete, starting with "http://" or "https://", and be fully-formed with a valid hostname (e.g., a domain name like "example.com" or an IP address). For example, "https://example.com" is valid, but "example.com" is not.

functionDeclarations.name: read_many_files
functionDeclarations.description:
Reads content from multiple files specified by paths or glob patterns within a configured target directory. For text files, it concatenates their content into a single string. It is primarily designed for text-based files. However, it can also process image (e.g., .png, .jpg) and PDF (.pdf) files if their file names or extensions are explicitly included in the 'paths' argument. For these explicitly requested non-text files, their data is read and included in a format suitable for model consumption (e.g., base64 encoded).

This tool is useful when you need to understand or analyze a collection of files, such as:
- Getting an overview of a codebase or parts of it (e.g., all TypeScript files in the 'src' directory).
- Finding where specific functionality is implemented if the user asks broad questions about code.
- Reviewing documentation files (e.g., all Markdown files in the 'docs' directory).
- Gathering context from multiple configuration files.
- When the user asks to "read all files in X directory" or "show me the content of all Y files".

Use this tool when the user's query implies needing the content of several files simultaneously for context, analysis, or summarization. For text files, it uses default UTF-8 encoding and a '--- {filePath} ---' separator between file contents. Ensure paths are relative to the target directory. Glob patterns like 'src/**/*.js' are supported. Avoid using for single files if a more specific single-file reading tool is available, unless the user specifically requests to process a list containing just one file via this tool. Other binary files (not explicitly requested as image/PDF) are generally skipped. Default excludes apply to common non-text files (except for explicitly requested images/PDFs) and large dependency directories unless 'useDefaultExcludes' is false.

paths.description: Required. An array of glob patterns or paths relative to the tool's target directory. Examples: ['src/**/*.ts'], ['README.md', 'docs/']

include.description: Optional. Additional glob patterns to include. These are merged with `paths`. Example: "*.test.ts" to specifically add test files if they were broadly excluded.

exclude.description: Optional. Glob patterns for files/directories to exclude. Added to default excludes if useDefaultExcludes is true. Example: "**/*.log", "temp/"

recursive.description: Optional. Whether to search recursively (primarily controlled by `**` in glob patterns). Defaults to true.

useDefaultExcludes.description: Optional. Whether to apply a list of default exclusion patterns (e.g., node_modules, .git, binary files). Defaults to true.

file_filtering_options.description: Whether to respect ignore patterns from .gitignore or .geminiignore

respect_git_ignore.description: Optional: Whether to respect .gitignore patterns when listing files. Only available in git repositories. Defaults to true.

respect_gemini_ignore.description: Optional: Whether to respect .geminiignore patterns when listing files. Defaults to true.

functionDeclarations.name: run_shell_command
functionDeclarations.description:
This tool executes a given shell command using the best available Windows shell (PowerShell Core, Windows PowerShell, or Command Prompt). Command can start background processes using `start /b`.

IMPORTANT:
- This tool is for terminal operations (e.g., git / npm / docker / build & test commands).
- DO NOT use this tool for file operations like reading, writing, editing, or searching files. Prefer the dedicated file tools for those actions.
- Quote any file path that contains spaces with double quotes, e.g. `cd "/path with spaces"` or `python "/path with spaces/script.py"`.
- This tool defaults to non-interactive execution. Set `interactive` to `true` only for a bare REPL such as `python` or `node`, or for a password prompt. Leave it unset for ordinary one-shot commands such as `git status`, `npm test`, `pytest`, or `rg foo`.
- If a command would produce very large output, prefer adding flags/filters (narrow paths, limit counts, request specific fields, machine-readable formats like JSON) to keep output small and unambiguous.
- Very large outputs may be returned as the most recent tail of the output. Earlier content may be truncated from the beginning. If the tool reports a "Full output saved to: <path>", prefer searching that file first (grep/rg or platform equivalents) for specific ERROR/WARN/FAIL/SUCCESS markers, then reading small slices (with `read_file` using `offset`/`limit`) instead of re-running expensive commands.

The following information is returned:
- Command: Executed command.
- Directory: Directory where command was executed, or `(root)`.
- Output: Combined command output (stdout/stderr). Can be `(empty)` or an excerpt if very large.
- Error: Error or `(none)` if no error was reported for the subprocess.
- Exit Code: Exit code or `(none)` if terminated by signal.
- Signal: Signal number or `(none)` if no signal was received.
- Background PIDs: List of background processes started or `(none)`.
- Process Group PGID: Process group started or `(none)`.

command.description: Exact command to execute using the best available Windows shell (automatically selected from PowerShell Core, Windows PowerShell, or Command Prompt). Quote any file paths containing spaces with double quotes.

description.description: Brief description of the command for the user. Be specific and concise. Ideally a single sentence. Can be up to 3 sentences for clarity. No line breaks.

directory.description: (OPTIONAL) The absolute path of the directory to run the command in. If not provided, the project root directory is used. Must be a directory within the workspace and must already exist.

interactive.description: Request an attached interactive shell session. Use `true` only for a bare REPL such as `python` or `node`, or for a password prompt. Leave it unset for normal one-shot commands like `git status`, `npm test`, `pytest`, or `rg foo`.

functionDeclarations.name: save_memory
functionDeclarations.description:
Saves a specific piece of information or fact to your long-term memory.

Use this tool:

- When the user explicitly asks you to remember something (e.g., "Remember that I like pineapple on pizza", "Please save this: my cat's name is Whiskers").
- When the user states a clear, concise fact about themselves, their preferences, or their environment that seems important for you to retain for future interactions to provide a more personalized and effective assistance.

Do NOT use this tool:

- To remember conversational context that is only relevant for the current session.
- To save long, complex, or rambling pieces of text. The fact should be relatively short and to the point.
- If you are unsure whether the information is a fact worth remembering long-term. If in doubt, you can ask the user, "Should I remember that for you?"

## Parameters

- `fact` (string, required): The specific fact or piece of information to remember. This should be a clear, self-contained statement. For example, if the user says "My favorite color is blue", the fact would be "My favorite color is blue".
- `scope` (string, optional): Where to save the memory:
  - "global": Saves to user-level ~/.codely-cli/CODELY.md (shared across all projects)
  - "project": Saves to current project's CODELY.md (project-specific)
  - If not specified, the tool will ask the user where they want to save the memory.

fact.description: The specific fact or piece of information to remember. Should be a clear, self-contained statement.

scope.description: Where to save the memory: "global" saves to user-level ~/.codely-cli/CODELY.md (shared across all projects), "project" saves to current project's CODELY.md (project-specific). If not specified, will prompt user to choose.

functionDeclarations.name: sequential_thinking
functionDeclarations.description:
A detailed tool for dynamic and reflective problem-solving through thoughts.
This tool helps analyze problems through a flexible thinking process that can adapt and evolve.
Each thought can build on, question, or revise previous insights as understanding deepens.

When to use this tool:
- Breaking down complex problems into steps
- Planning and design with room for revision
- Analysis that might need course correction
- Problems where the full scope might not be clear initially
- Problems that require a multi-step solution
- Tasks that need to maintain context over multiple steps
- Situations where irrelevant information needs to be filtered out

Key features:
- You can adjust total_thoughts up or down as you progress
- You can question or revise previous thoughts
- You can add more thoughts even after reaching what seemed like the end
- You can express uncertainty and explore alternative approaches
- Not every thought needs to build linearly - you can branch or backtrack
- Generates a solution hypothesis
- Verifies the hypothesis based on the Chain of Thought steps
- Repeats the process until satisfied
- Provides a correct answer

Parameters explained:
- thought: Your current thinking step, which can include:
* Regular analytical steps
* Revisions of previous thoughts
* Questions about previous decisions
* Realizations about needing more analysis
* Changes in approach
* Hypothesis generation
* Hypothesis verification
- next_thought_needed: True if you need more thinking, even if at what seemed like the end
- thought_number: Current number in sequence (can go beyond initial total if needed)
- total_thoughts: Current estimate of thoughts needed (can be adjusted up/down)
- is_revision: A boolean indicating if this thought revises previous thinking
- revises_thought: If is_revision is true, which thought number is being reconsidered
- branch_from_thought: If branching, which thought number is the branching point
- branch_id: Identifier for the current branch (if any)
- needs_more_thoughts: If reaching end but realizing more thoughts needed

You should:
1. Start with an initial estimate of needed thoughts, but be ready to adjust
2. Feel free to question or revise previous thoughts
3. Don't hesitate to add more thoughts if needed, even at the "end"
4. Express uncertainty when present
5. Mark thoughts that revise previous thinking or branch into new paths
6. Ignore information that is irrelevant to the current step
7. Generate a solution hypothesis when appropriate
8. Verify the hypothesis based on the Chain of Thought steps
9. Repeat the process until satisfied with the solution
10. Provide a single, ideally correct answer as the final output
11. Only set next_thought_needed to false when truly done and a satisfactory answer is reached

next_thought_needed.description: Whether another thought step is needed

thought_number.description: Current thought number. Minimum value is 1.

total_thoughts.description: Estimated total thoughts needed. Minimum value is 1.

revises_thought.description: Which thought is being reconsidered. Minimum value is 1.

branch_from_thought.description: Branching point thought number. Minimum value is 1.

functionDeclarations.name: web_search
functionDeclarations.description:
Searches the internet/web for information using a search query. Use this tool when you need to search for information online but do NOT have a specific URL. Returns search results with titles, snippets, and source URLs.

When to use:
- User asks to "search the web" or "find information about X"
- You need current information, news, or documentation from the internet
- You need to discover web pages related to a topic
- You have a search query but no specific URL

When NOT to use:
- You already have a specific URL (use web_fetch instead)
- User provides a direct URL to access

Example: web_search(query="latest AI developments")

query.description: The search query to find information on the web.

functionDeclarations.name: ask_user
functionDeclarations.description: Ask the user one or more questions to gather preferences, clarify requirements, or make decisions.

question.description: The complete question to ask the user. Should be clear, specific, and end with a question mark.

header.description: Very short label displayed as a chip/tag. MUST be 16 characters or fewer.

type.description: Question type: 'choice' (default) for multiple-choice with options, 'text' for free-form input, 'yesno' for Yes/No confirmation.

options.description: Selectable choices for 'choice' type questions. Provide 2-4 options.

multiSelect.description: Only applies when type='choice'. Set to true to allow selecting multiple options.

placeholder.description: Hint text shown in the input field. For type='text', shown in the main input. For type='choice', shown in the 'Other' custom input.

functionDeclarations.name: exit_plan_mode
functionDeclarations.description: Request approval for a plan and exit plan mode to begin implementation. The plan file must be a .md file in the designated plans directory.

plan_file_path.description: The absolute path to the plan file (.md) in the plans directory.

functionDeclarations.name: analyze_multimedia
functionDeclarations.description:
Analyzes images, videos, and audio files using a multimodal model. This tool accepts local file paths, base64 data, or URLs to multimedia content. Supported formats include common image types (PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP, BMP), video formats (MP4, MKV, OGG), and audio formats (MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, M4A).

Key capabilities:
• Visual Agent: Operates PC/mobile GUIs, recognizes UI elements, understands functions, can guide through interface interactions
• Visual Coding: Generates Draw.io diagrams, HTML/CSS/JS code from images/videos
• Text Extraction: Reads and extracts all text from images including documents, receipts, screenshots
• Spatial Perception: Judges object positions, viewpoints, occlusions, provides 2D grounding
• Content Analysis: Describes scenes, identifies objects, analyzes actions in videos
• Audio Understanding: Transcribes speech, identifies sounds, analyzes audio content
• Technical Understanding: Interprets charts, diagrams, technical drawings, code screenshots

The model responds based on your specific prompt. Examples: 'Extract all text from this receipt', 'Generate HTML code for this UI design', 'Identify all clickable elements in this screenshot', 'Describe the spatial relationships between objects', 'Transcribe the speech in this audio', 'What sounds are in this recording?'.

content.description: The multimedia content. For 'absolute_path': provide the absolute file path. For 'base64': provide base64 data (with or without 'data:mime/type;base64,' prefix). For 'url': provide the complete URL starting with http:// or https://.

prompt.description: The prompt or question to ask about the multimedia content. Be specific about what you want to know. Examples: 'Describe what you see in this image', 'Extract all text from this receipt', 'Generate HTML/CSS code for this UI design', 'Identify all clickable elements and their functions in this screenshot', 'What actions are happening in this video?', 'Create a Draw.io diagram based on this flowchart image', 'Describe the spatial relationships between objects', 'What UI components are visible and how can I interact with them?', 'Transcribe the speech in this audio file', 'What sounds can you hear in this recording?', 'Identify the speakers in this conversation'.

functionDeclarations.name: task
functionDeclarations.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks autonomously.

The Task tool launches specialized agents that autonomously handle complex tasks. Each agent has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agents (use these names as the subagent_name value):
- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

When using the Task tool, you must set the subagent_name parameter to one of the agent names listed above (e.g., "general-purpose").

When NOT to use the Task tool:
- If you want to read a specific file path, use the read_file or glob tool instead of the Task tool, to find the match more quickly
- If you are searching for a specific class definition like "class Foo", use the glob tool instead, to find the match more quickly
- If you are searching for code within a specific file or set of 2-3 files, use the read_file tool instead of the Task tool, to find the match more quickly
- Other tasks that are not related to the agent descriptions above

Usage notes:
- Always include a short description (3-5 words) summarizing what the agent will do
- Launch multiple agents concurrently whenever possible, to maximize performance; to do that, use a single message with multiple tool uses
- When the agent is done, it will return a single message back to you. The result returned by the agent is not visible to the user. To show the user the result, you should send a text message back to the user with a concise summary of the result.
- You can optionally run agents in the background using the run_in_background parameter. When an agent runs in the background, you will be notified when it completes.
- If this execution corresponds to an existing planned job, pass job_id so the linked job is auto-claimed and auto-updated on completion/failure.
- IMPORTANT: After launching background tasks, do NOT call `task_output` to poll or block — continue with other work or respond to the user. When a background task finishes, a `<bg_task_done task_id="..." name="..." status="...">result</bg_task_done>` message is automatically injected into the conversation containing the task result. Use this directly, and only use `task_output` if the result was truncated or you need additional details.
- Provide clear, detailed prompts so the agent can work autonomously and return exactly the information you need.
- The agent's outputs should generally be trusted
- Clearly tell the agent whether you expect it to write code or just to do research (search, file reads, web fetches, etc.), since it is not aware of the user's intent
- If the agent description mentions that it should be used proactively, then you should try your best to use it without the user having to ask for it first. Use your judgement.
- If the user specifies that they want you to run agents "in parallel", you MUST send a single message with multiple Task tool use content blocks.

Example usage:
<example>
user: "Please refactor the authentication module to use JWT"
assistant: First let me explore the existing auth implementation.
assistant: Uses the Task tool to launch a general-purpose agent to search for and understand the current authentication code
assistant: Based on the exploration results, I'll now implement the JWT refactoring.
</example>
<example>
user: "Where is the database connection configured?"
assistant: Uses the Task tool to launch a general-purpose agent to find database configuration files
</example>

name.description: A human-readable task name for display (e.g. "Refactor login module"). Required.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task.

prompt.description: The full task instructions for the agent to perform.

subagent_name.description: The agent to use for this task. Must be one of the names listed in the "Available agents" section above (e.g., "general-purpose").

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this agent in the background. You will be notified when it completes with the result.

job_id.description: Optional existing job ID to link this task to. When provided, the linked job is auto-claimed as in_progress and auto-updated on completion/failure.

functionDeclarations.name: task_output
functionDeclarations.description:
Retrieves output for one or more tasks (always non-blocking).
- Use task_id for a single task, or task_ids[] for batch query
- For running tasks: returns stable metadata (status/name/output_file)
- For terminal tasks: includes parsed result summary and complete_task args (when available)
- IMPORTANT: This tool returns immediately with a status snapshot. Do NOT use it to poll or wait for task completion. Rely on <bg_task_done> events instead.

parametersJsonSchema.description: Provide either task_id (single) or task_ids (batch), not both.

task_id.description: A single task ID to query. Required if task_ids is not provided.

task_ids.description: Batch query: multiple task IDs. Required if task_id is not provided. Mutually exclusive with task_id.

functionDeclarations.name: task_stop
functionDeclarations.description:
Stops a running background task by its ID.
- Takes a task_id parameter identifying the task to stop
- Returns a success or failure status

task_id.description: The ID of the background task to stop.

functionDeclarations.name: job_create
functionDeclarations.description:
Use this tool to create a structured task list for your current coding session. This helps you track progress, organize complex tasks, and demonstrate thoroughness to the user.
It also helps the user understand the progress of the job and overall progress of their requests.

## When to Use This Tool
Use this tool proactively in these scenarios:
- Complex multi-step tasks - When a job requires 3 or more distinct steps or actions
- Non-trivial and complex tasks - Jobs that require careful planning or multiple operations
- Plan mode - When using plan mode, create a job list to track the work
- User explicitly requests job list - When the user directly asks you to use the job list
- User provides multiple tasks - When users provide a list of things to be done (numbered or comma-separated)
- After receiving new instructions - Immediately capture user requirements as jobs
- When you start working on a job - Mark it as in_progress BEFORE beginning work
- After completing a job - Mark it as completed and add any new follow-up jobs discovered during implementation

## When NOT to Use This Tool
Skip using this tool when:
- There is only a single, straightforward job
- The job is trivial and tracking it provides no organizational benefit
- The job can be completed in less than 3 trivial steps
- The job is purely conversational or informational

NOTE that you should not use this tool if there is only one trivial job to do. In this case you are better off just doing the job directly.

## Job Fields
- **subject**: A brief, actionable title in imperative form (e.g., "Fix authentication bug in login flow")
- **description**: Detailed description of what needs to be done, including context and acceptance criteria
- **activeForm**: Present continuous form shown in spinner when job is in_progress (e.g., "Fixing authentication bug"). This is displayed to the user while you work on the job.

**IMPORTANT**: Always provide activeForm when creating jobs. The subject should be imperative ("Run tests") while activeForm should be present continuous ("Running tests"). All jobs are created with status `pending`.

## Tips
- Create jobs with clear, specific subjects that describe the outcome
- Include enough detail in the description for another agent to understand and complete the job
- After creating jobs, use job_update to set up dependencies (blocks/blockedBy) if needed
- Check job_list first to avoid creating duplicate jobs

subject.description: A brief title for the job

description.description: A detailed description of what needs to be done

activeForm.description: Present continuous form shown in spinner when in_progress (e.g., "Running tests")

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata to attach to the job

functionDeclarations.name: job_get
functionDeclarations.description:
Use this tool to retrieve a job by its ID from the job list.

## When to Use This Tool
- When you need the full description and context before starting work on a job
- To understand job dependencies (what it blocks, what blocks it)
- After being assigned a job, to get complete requirements

## Output
Returns full job details:
- **subject**: Job title
- **description**: Detailed requirements and context
- **status**: 'pending', 'in_progress', or 'completed'
- **blocks**: Jobs waiting on this one to complete
- **blockedBy**: Jobs that must complete before this one can start

## Tips
- After fetching a job, verify its blockedBy list is empty before beginning work.
- Use job_list to see all jobs in summary form.

jobId.description: The ID of the job to retrieve

functionDeclarations.name: job_update
functionDeclarations.description:
Use this tool to update a job in the job list.

## When to Use This Tool
**Mark jobs as resolved:**
- When you have completed the work described in a job
- When a job is no longer needed or has been superseded
- IMPORTANT: Always mark your assigned jobs as resolved when you finish them
- After resolving, call job_list to find your next job
- ONLY mark a job as completed when you have FULLY accomplished it
- If you encounter errors, blockers, or cannot finish, keep the job as in_progress
- When blocked, create a new job describing what needs to be resolved
- Never mark a job as completed if:
  - Tests are failing
  - Implementation is partial
  - You encountered unresolved errors
  - You couldn't find necessary files or dependencies

**Delete jobs:**
- When a job is no longer relevant or was created in error
- Setting status to `deleted` permanently removes the job

**Update job details:**
- When requirements change or become clearer
- When establishing dependencies between jobs

## Fields You Can Update
- **status**: The job status (see Status Workflow below)
- **subject**: Change the job title (imperative form, e.g., "Run tests")
- **description**: Change the job description
- **activeForm**: Present continuous form shown in spinner when in_progress (e.g., "Running tests")
- **owner**: Change the job owner identifier. When a job is auto-linked to a `task`, this is typically the execution task ID (e.g. `task-1`).

Mark job as completed after finishing work:

# NePy Python 类注册问题排查记录

**日期**: 2026-04-05  
**问题**: TPSCharacter 类无法在 UE 编辑器中作为 Blueprint 基类被找到

---

## 问题描述

在 UE 5.6 + NePy 插件环境下，创建了 `TPSCharacter` Python 类并使用 `@ue.uclass()` 装饰器，但在编辑器中创建 Blueprint 时无法搜索到该类。

---

## 问题根因分析

### 问题 1: 文件名与目录冲突

**现象**: 
- `import character` 后，`TPSCharacter` 类没有被注册
- `on_init` 中导入模块没有报错，但类不出现在 Blueprint 列表中

**根因**:
```
Content/Scripts/
├── character.py          # 包含 TPSCharacter 类
└── character/            # Python 包目录
    ├── __init__.py
    ├── base_character.py
    └── ...
```

Python 导入规则：当文件和目录同名时，`import character` 会导入**目录（包）**而不是**文件**。

**解决方案**:
将 `character.py` 重命名为 `tps_character.py`，并在 `nepyinit.py` 中改为：
```python
import tps_character  # 而不是 import character
```

---

### 问题 2: `__init__` 方法不允许

**现象**:
```
LogNePython: Warning: User defined '__init__' in subclassing type 'BaseCharacter', 
which is not allowed and will take no effect. 
Use '__init_default__' instead if you want to define default values in unreal type. 
Use '__init_pyobj__' instead if you want to define python variables.
```

**根因**:
NePy 的 `@ue.uclass()` 装饰的类不能使用标准的 `__init__` 方法。

**解决方案**:
```python
# 错误写法
class BaseCharacter(ue.Character):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.movement = None

# 正确写法
@ue.uclass()
class BaseCharacter(ue.Character):
    def __init_pyobj__(self):
        """初始化 Python 变量"""
        self.movement = None
```

---

### 问题 3: InputSettings API 调用方式错误

**现象**:
```
AttributeError: 'module' object has no attribute 'GetInputSettings'
```

**根因**:
`GetInputSettings` 是 `InputSettings` 类的静态方法，不是 `ue` 模块的直接属性。

**解决方案**:
```python
# 错误写法
input_settings = ue.GetInputSettings()

# 正确写法
input_settings = ue.InputSettings.GetInputSettings()
```

---

### 问题 4: 基类缺少 `@ue.uclass()` 装饰器

**现象**:
- 子类 `TPSCharacter` 有装饰器，但基类 `BaseCharacter` 没有
- 类仍然无法注册

**根因**:
NePy 要求所有作为 Blueprint 基类的 Python 类（包括继承链中的基类）都必须有 `@ue.uclass()` 装饰器。

**解决方案**:
```python
# 错误写法
class BaseCharacter(ue.Character):  # 缺少装饰器
    pass

# 正确写法
@ue.uclass()
class BaseCharacter(ue.Character):
    pass
```

---

## 最佳实践总结

### 1. 文件命名规范

- 避免模块文件与目录同名
- 建议命名方式：
  - `tps_character.py` - 具体角色类
  - `character/` - 角色相关组件包目录

### 2. NePy 类定义规范

```python
import ue

@ue.uclass()
class MyCharacter(ue.Character):
    """使用 __init_pyobj__ 初始化 Python 变量"""
    
    def __init_pyobj__(self):
        self.my_variable = None
    
    def ReceiveBeginPlay(self):
        """覆写 UE 事件"""
        super().ReceiveBeginPlay()
        ue.LogWarning(f"{self} started!")
```

### 3. 类注册时机

Python 类必须在 `on_init()` 回调中导入，才能在编辑器启动时注册：

```python
# nepyinit.py
def on_init():
    ue.LogWarning('NePy initialized!')
    
    # 注册 Python 类（必须在 on_init 中导入）
    import tps_character
    
    # 其他初始化...
```

### 4. API 调用检查

使用 NePy API 前，检查 `ue/__init__.pyi` 类型存根文件确认正确的调用方式：
- 实例方法：`obj.Method()`
- 静态方法：`ue.ClassName.StaticMethod()`

---

## 调试技巧

### 1. 添加日志确认模块加载

```python
def on_init():

    try:
        import tps_character
        ue.LogWarning('tps_character module loaded successfully!')
    except Exception as e:
        ue.LogError(f'Failed to load tps_character: {e}')
```

在 UE 编辑器中：
- `Tools` → `Output Log`
- 过滤 `LogNePython` 查看所有 Python 相关日志

# -*- encoding: utf-8 -*-
"""角色基类"""

import ue
from .movement import MovementComponent
from .camera import CameraComponent
from .shooting import ShootingComponent


@ue.uclass()
class BaseCharacter(ue.Character):
    """
    角色基类，使用组件组合模式
    
    子类可以继承并重写各方法来自定义行为
    """
    
    def __init_pyobj__(self):
        """初始化 Python 变量（NePy 要求用 __init_pyobj__ 代替 __init__）"""
        # 组件实例
        self.movement = None
        self.camera = None
        self.shooting = None
        self.input_handler = None
    
    @ue.ufunction(override=True)
    def ReceiveBeginPlay(self):
        """角色开始播放时调用"""
        ue.Log(f"{self} ReceiveBeginPlay")
        
        # 初始化组件
        self._init_components()
    
    def _init_components(self):
        """初始化所有组件"""
        # 创建移动组件
        self.movement = MovementComponent(self)
        
        # 创建摄像机组件
        self.camera = CameraComponent(self)
        self.camera.setup()
        
        # 创建射击组件
        self.shooting = ShootingComponent(self)
        
        ue.Log(f"BaseCharacter: Components initialized for {self}")
    
    def set_input_handler(self, handler):
        """
        设置输入处理器
        
        Args:
            handler: InputHandler 实例
        """
        self.input_handler = handler
        handler.set_components(self.movement, self.camera, self.shooting)
        handler.bind()
        ue.Log(f"BaseCharacter: Input handler set to {handler.__class__.__name__}")
    
    def set_bullet_class(self, bullet_class):
        """
        设置子弹类
        
        Args:
            bullet_class: 子弹 Actor 类
        """
        if self.shooting:
            self.shooting.set_bullet_class(bullet_class)
    
    @ue.ufunction(override=True)
    def ReceiveTick(self, delta_time: float):
        """
        每帧更新
        
        Args:
            delta_time: 帧间隔时间
        """
        # 更新摄像机组件（平滑过渡）
        if self.camera:
            self.camera.tick(delta_time)
        
        # 更新输入处理器（移动、射击等）
        if self.input_handler:
            self.input_handler.tick(delta_time)
    
    @ue.ufunction(override=True)
    def ReceiveEndPlay(self, end_play_reason):
        """角色结束播放时调用"""
        if self.input_handler:
            self.input_handler.unbind()
        ue.Log(f"{self} ReceiveEndPlay")

分析完毕，以下是项目概览：

---

## 项目概况

这是一个 **TPS 第三人称射击游戏 Demo**，使用 **UE5.6 + NePy 插件**（Python 绑定）开发，属于网易2026初入江湖培训作业。

## 核心功能（已设计/部分实现）

| 功能 | 状态 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| WASD 移动 | ✅ 已实现 | `MovementComponent`，基于摄像机方向 |
| 空格跳跃 | ✅ 已实现 | `MovementComponent.jump()` |
| TPS 越肩摄像机 | ✅ 已实现 | `CameraComponent`，SpringArm + 摄像机偏移 |
| 鼠标左键射击 | ✅ 已实现 | `ShootingComponent` + `Bullet` 子弹类 |
| 鼠标右键瞄准 | ✅ 已实现 | 开镜拉近摄像机，角色转向摄像机方向 |
| 动态输入映射 | ✅ 已实现 | `InputConfig`，Python 代码动态添加 Axis/Action Mappings |
| 动画蓝图 | ⚠️ 文档已写 | 有教程，但蓝图文件 `Content/Characters/Mannequins/Anims/AnimBluePrint/` 是未追踪的新目录 |

## 架构

采用**组件组合模式**，`TPSCharacter → BaseCharacter → ue.Character`：
- `MovementComponent` — 移动/跳跃
- `CameraComponent` — 摄像机/瞄准
- `ShootingComponent` — 射击/连发
- `InputHandler(ABC)` → `KeyboardInputHandler` — 输入绑定（UE InputComponent）
- `Bullet` — 子弹 Actor（纯 Python，含视觉和投射移动）

## Git 进度（4 次提交）

| 提交 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `0275f5a` | Initial commit: 项目初始化 + NePy 插件 |
| `8b712de` | docs: 角色控制设计文档 |
| `40158cf` | docs: 角色控制实现计划 |
| `77a95cf` | **完成角色移动与动画绑定**（最新，核心代码全在这） |

## 当前未提交的改动

有 **8 个修改文件 + 1 个新增文件 + 2 个未追踪目录**，主要是：
- `bullet.py` — 新增子弹类
- `camera.py` — 新增瞄准功能
- `shooting.py` — 新增连发逻辑
- `tps_character.py` — 新增手动 Possess、InputConfig 调用
- `keyboard_handler.py` — 新增瞄准 Action 绑定
- 动画蓝图目录（`AnimBluePrint/`）尚未 git add

**总结：核心游戏逻辑（移动、跳跃、射击、瞄准）的 Python 代码已基本完成，但还有未提交的改动。动画蓝图部分有教程文档和 uasset 文件，但尚未完全集成。**

3. **重定向 MF 动画**：

## 原因

动画的设计意图是：**角色面朝摄像机方向，腿往侧面迈**。

```
        摄像机
          ↓
    ←←←←← 角色（面朝屏幕/前方）
```

但你的角色大概率开了 `bOrientRotationToMovement = True`（CharacterMovementComponent 默认值），角色会**转向移动方向**。这时候侧身动画就穿帮了——角色转身面朝左，但动画里腿还在往"角色的左边"迈，看起来就像面朝右往后跑。

```
  角色（已转向左）
  ↓
  ←←←←  实际动画还是"侧身往左迈步" → 看起来像往后跑
```

## 两种解法

### 方案 A：TPS 标准做法 — 关闭朝向移动，用侧身

```
bOrientRotationToMovement = False
bUseControllerRotationYaw = False
```

角色始终面朝摄像机方向，A/D 是侧移，W/S 是前进后退。这就是 8 方向动画的正确用法——**所有方向都是相对于摄像机方向的**。

### 方案 B：简单做法 — 开启朝向移动，只用 Fwd

```
bOrientRotationToMovement = True
```

角色自动转向移动方向，但只需要一个 BlendSpace 用 `Jog_Fwd`，不需要 Left/Right 等侧身动画。缺点是角色始终面朝跑动方向，没有侧移/倒退，不适合 TPS 射击。

---

**你的项目是 TPS 射击游戏，应该用方案 A。** 角色面朝摄像机，8 方向动画才能正确播放。需要在 `TPSCharacterBP` 蓝图的 `CharacterMovementComponent` 里把 `Orient Rotation to Movement` **取消勾选**，或者 Python 代码里设置：

```python
self.CharacterMovement.bOrientRotationToMovement = False
```

现在我对你的 `ABP_Rifle` 有了完整的了解，总结一下四张截图的内容：

## 你的 ABP_Rifle 结构

**Event Graph：**
- `Event Blueprint Update Animation` → `Try Get Pawn Owner` → `Is Valid`
- 获取 Velocity（向量）和 Actor Rotation
- `Calculate Direction`（Velocity + Base Rotation → 方向角度）
- SET `velocity`（Vector）、SET `Direction`（Float）

**AnimGraph：**
- `GroundLocomotion`（状态机）→ `Output Pose`

**状态机 GroundLocomotion：**
- `Entry` → `idle` ↔ `movement`（双向过渡）

**movement 状态内部：**
- `Velocity` → `Vector Length` → `Speed`（浮点）
- `Direction` → 直接送入 BlendSpace
- `MovementBS`（BlendSpace 2D：Direction × Speed）→ `Output Pose`

**MovementBS（BlendSpace）：**
- X轴：Direction（-180 ~ 180）
- Y轴：Speed（0 ~ 600）
- 只有 4 个采样点：中心底(0,0)、中心顶(0,600)、左底(-180,0)、右底(180,0)

## 存在的问题

| 问题 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **BlendSpace 采样点太少** | 只有4个点，缺少 (-90, 600)、(90, 600) 等侧跑动画，导致侧移时动画过渡不自然 |
| **用了 Pistol 动画** | 资产浏览器里是 `MF_Pistol_Jog_*`，不是 `MF_Rifle_Jog_*`，持枪姿势和持步枪不一致 |
| **idle 状态是空的** | 你只展示了 movement 状态的内容，idle 状态里放了什么？ |
| **没有瞄准状态** | 右键瞄准的 `bIsAiming` 变量和状态机里的过渡都还没加 |
| **没有跳跃状态** | `bIsInAir` 和跳跃动画也没有 |
| **过渡条件没看到** | idle ↔ movement 的过渡规则是什么？Speed > 0？ |

你打算先把哪个问题解决？还是先把整个动画蓝图的结构补全？

当前项目中的摄像机控制是怎么实现的，是py代码控制的吗，从哪里获取鼠标输入

<think>The user wants to understand how the camera control works in their project - specifically how mouse input is captured and used to control the camera. Let me trace the data flow through the code I've already read.

From the code I've already read:

1. `input_config.py` - Dynamically creates input mappings including:
   - Axis: `Turn` (MouseX, scale 1.0), `LookUp` (MouseY, scale -1.0)

2. `keyboard_handler.py` - Binds these axes:
   - `input_comp.BindAxis("Turn", self._on_turn)`
   - `input_comp.BindAxis("LookUp", self._on_look_up)`

3. These callbacks store the values:
   - `_on_turn` → `self._turn_rate = value`
   - `_on_look_up` → `self._look_up_rate = value`

4. In `tick()`, these values are passed to camera:
   - `self.camera.update_rotation(self._turn_rate, 0.0)`
   - `self.camera.update_rotation(0.0, self._look_up_rate)`

5. `camera.py` - `update_rotation()`:
   - `self.owner.AddControllerYawInput(yaw_delta)`
   - `self.owner.AddControllerPitchInput(pitch_delta)`

6. `camera.py` - `setup()`:
   - Creates SpringArm with `bUsePawnControlRotation = True`
   - So the SpringArm follows the Controller's rotation

So the flow is: UE Input System (MouseX/MouseY) → InputComponent BindAxis callbacks → KeyboardInputHandler tick → CameraComponent.update_rotation → AddControllerYawInput/AddControllerPitchInput → Controller rotation → SpringArm follows controller rotation (because bUsePawnControlRotation=True)

Let me also check the DefaultEngine.ini for any input settings.</think>是的，完全由 Python 代码控制。完整的数据流如下：

## 鼠标输入链路

```
UE Input System (MouseX/MouseY)
    ↓
InputComponent.BindAxis 回调
    ↓
KeyboardInputHandler 缓存值
    ↓
tick() 每帧传给 CameraComponent
    ↓
AddControllerYawInput / AddControllerPitchInput
    ↓
Controller 旋转
    ↓
SpringArm (bUsePawnControlRotation=True) 跟随 Controller 旋转
```

## 逐层追踪

### 1. 输入映射（`input_config.py`）

动态注册了两个轴映射：

```python
{"AxisName": "Turn",   "Key": "MouseX", "Scale": 1.0},
{"AxisName": "LookUp", "Key": "MouseY", "Scale": -1.0},  # Y取反因为鼠标下移=抬头
```

### 2. 绑定回调（`keyboard_handler.py`）

在 `bind()` 中绑定 UE 的 InputComponent：

```python
input_comp.BindAxis("Turn", self._on_turn)
input_comp.BindAxis("LookUp", self._on_look_up)
```

鼠标移动时 UE 自动调用回调，把增量值存起来：

```python
def _on_turn(self, value):
    self._turn_rate = value       # 水平旋转增量

def _on_look_up(self, value):
    self._look_up_rate = value    # 垂直旋转增量
```

### 3. 每帧驱动摄像机（`keyboard_handler.py` → `camera.py`）

`tick()` 中把缓存的值传给 CameraComponent：

```python
# 水平旋转
if self._turn_rate != 0.0:
    self.camera.update_rotation(self._turn_rate, 0.0)
# 垂直旋转
if self._look_up_rate != 0.0:
    self.camera.update_rotation(0.0, self._look_up_rate)
```

### 4. 实际旋转 Controller（`camera.py`）

```python
def update_rotation(self, yaw_delta, pitch_delta):
    self.owner.AddControllerYawInput(yaw_delta)    # 改 Controller 的 Yaw
    self.owner.AddControllerPitchInput(pitch_delta) # 改 Controller 的 Pitch
```

### 5. 摄像机跟随

`setup()` 中创建 SpringArm 时设了：

```python
self.spring_arm.bUsePawnControlRotation = True  # 关键！让 SpringArm 跟随 Controller 旋转
```

SpringArm 根据 Controller 的旋转方向自动调整朝向，Camera 挂在 SpringArm 末端，就实现了鼠标控制视角。

## 总结

**鼠标输入来自 UE 引擎底层的 InputComponent**，Python 代码只是通过 `BindAxis` 接收增量值，然后调用 `AddControllerYawInput/PitchInput` 旋转 Controller，SpringArm 跟随 Controller 旋转从而带动摄像机。

UE5 默认值是 **600.0 cm/s**（6米/秒），这正好和你 BlendSpace 的 Speed 轴最大值 600 对上了。

| 参数 | 值 | 说明 |
|------|-----|------|
| `move_speed` | 1.0 | 定义了但**没用到**，是个摆设 |
| Axis 输入值 | W=1.0 / S=-1.0 | 仅做方向缩放 |
| `MaxWalkSpeed` | 600.0（UE默认） | **这才是实际移动速度** |
| BlendSpace Speed 轴 | 0~600 | 和 MaxWalkSpeed 匹配 |

A detailed tool for dynamic and reflective problem-solving through thoughts.
This tool helps analyze problems through a flexible thinking process that can adapt and evolve.
Each thought can build on, question, or revise previous insights as understanding deepens.

When to use this tool:
- Breaking down complex problems into steps
- Planning and design with room for revision
- Analysis that might need course correction
- Problems where the full scope might not be clear initially
- Problems that require a multi-step solution
- Tasks that need to maintain context over multiple steps
- Situations where irrelevant information needs to be filtered out

Key features:
- You can adjust total_thoughts up or down as you progress
- You can question or revise previous thoughts
- You can add more thoughts even after reaching what seemed like the end
- You can express uncertainty and explore alternative approaches
- Not every thought needs to build linearly - you can branch or backtrack
- Generates a solution hypothesis
- Verifies the hypothesis based on the Chain of Thought steps
- Repeats the process until satisfied
- Provides a correct answer

Parameters explained:
- thought: Your current thinking step, which can include:
* Regular analytical steps
* Revisions of previous thoughts
* Questions about previous decisions
* Realizations about needing more analysis
* Changes in approach
* Hypothesis generation
* Hypothesis verification
- next_thought_needed: True if you need more thinking, even if at what seemed like the end
- thought_number: Current number in sequence (can go beyond initial total if needed)
- total_thoughts: Current estimate of thoughts needed (can be adjusted up/down)
- is_revision: A boolean indicating if this thought revises previous thinking
- revises_thought: If is_revision is true, which thought number is being reconsidered
- branch_from_thought: If branching, which thought number is the branching point
- branch_id: Identifier for the current branch (if any)
- needs_more_thoughts: If reaching end but realizing more thoughts needed

You should:

2. Feel free to question or revise previous thoughts
3. Don't hesitate to add more thoughts if needed, even at the "end"
4. Express uncertainty when present
5. Mark thoughts that revise previous thinking or branch into new paths
6. Ignore information that is irrelevant to the current step
7. Generate a solution hypothesis when appropriate
8. Verify the hypothesis based on the Chain of Thought steps
9. Repeat the process until satisfied with the solution
10. Provide a single, ideally correct answer as the final output

# -*- encoding: utf-8 -*-
"""
输入配置 - 动态创建 Input Mappings

B1 方式：Python 代码动态添加 Axis/Action Mappings
无需在编辑器中手动配置项目设置

使用方法：
    InputConfig.setup()  # 在游戏初始化时调用一次
"""

import ue


class InputConfig:
    """
    输入配置管理器
    
    使用 ue.GetInputSettings() 动态添加 Axis/Action Mappings
    完全不需要在编辑器中手动配置
    """
    
    _initialized = False
    
    # ========================================
    # Axis Mappings 定义
    # ========================================
    AXIS_MAPPINGS = [
        # 移动轴
        {"AxisName": "MoveForward", "Key": "W", "Scale": 1.0},
        {"AxisName": "MoveForward", "Key": "S", "Scale": -1.0},
        {"AxisName": "MoveRight", "Key": "D", "Scale": 1.0},
        {"AxisName": "MoveRight", "Key": "A", "Scale": -1.0},
        # 视角轴
        {"AxisName": "Turn", "Key": "MouseX", "Scale": 1.0},
        {"AxisName": "LookUp", "Key": "MouseY", "Scale": -1.0},
    ]
    
    # ========================================
    # Action Mappings 定义
    # ========================================
    ACTION_MAPPINGS = [
        {"ActionName": "Jump", "Key": "SpaceBar"},
        {"ActionName": "Fire", "Key": "LeftMouseButton"},
        {"ActionName": "Aim", "Key": "RightMouseButton"},
    ]
    
    @classmethod
    def setup(cls, force: bool = False):
        """
        设置输入映射
        
        在游戏初始化时调用一次，动态添加所有 Axis/Action Mappings
        
        Args:
            force: 强制重新初始化
        """
        if cls._initialized and not force:
            ue.Log("InputConfig: Already initialized")
            return
        
        if force:
            cls._initialized = False
        
        ue.Log("InputConfig: Setting up dynamic input mappings...")
        
        # 获取 InputSettings（静态方法）
        input_settings = ue.InputSettings.GetInputSettings()
        if not input_settings:
            ue.LogError("InputConfig: Failed to get InputSettings!")
            return
        
        # 添加 Axis Mappings
        for mapping in cls.AXIS_MAPPINGS:
            cls._add_axis_mapping(input_settings, mapping)
        
        # 添加 Action Mappings
        for mapping in cls.ACTION_MAPPINGS:
            cls._add_action_mapping(input_settings, mapping)
        
        # 强制重建按键映射
        input_settings.ForceRebuildKeymaps()
        
        cls._initialized = True
        ue.LogWarning("InputConfig: Dynamic input mappings complete!")
    
    @classmethod
    def _add_axis_mapping(cls, input_settings, mapping: dict):
        """
        添加轴映射
        
        Args:
            input_settings: ue.InputSettings 实例
            mapping: {"AxisName": str, "Key": str, "Scale": float}
        """
        axis_name = mapping["AxisName"]
        key_name = mapping["Key"]
        scale = mapping.get("Scale", 1.0)
        
        try:
            # 创建 InputAxisKeyMapping
            axis_mapping = ue.InputAxisKeyMapping()
            axis_mapping.AxisName = axis_name
            axis_mapping.Key = ue.Key(key_name)
            axis_mapping.Scale = scale
            
            # 添加到 InputSettings
            input_settings.AddAxisMapping(axis_mapping, True)
            ue.Log(f"  Added Axis: {axis_name} <- {key_name} (scale: {scale})")
            
        except Exception as e:
            ue.LogWarning(f"  Failed to add axis {axis_name}: {e}")
    
    @classmethod
    def _add_action_mapping(cls, input_settings, mapping: dict):
        """
        添加动作映射
        
        Args:
            input_settings: ue.InputSettings 实例
            mapping: {"ActionName": str, "Key": str}
        """
        action_name = mapping["ActionName"]
        key_name = mapping["Key"]
        
        try:
            # 创建 InputActionKeyMapping
            action_mapping = ue.InputActionKeyMapping()
            action_mapping.ActionName = action_name
            action_mapping.Key = ue.Key(key_name)
            
            # 添加到 InputSettings
            input_settings.AddActionMapping(action_mapping, True)
            ue.Log(f"  Added Action: {action_name} <- {key_name}")
            
        except Exception as e:
            ue.LogWarning(f"  Failed to add action {action_name}: {e}")
    
    @classmethod
    def is_initialized(cls) -> bool:
        """检查是否已初始化"""
        return cls._initialized

import ue


@ue.uclass()
class Bullet(ue.Actor):
    """
    子弹 Actor
    
    纯 Python 实现，使用 ProjectileMovementComponent 控制移动
    """
    
    # 子弹参数
    BULLET_SPEED = 3000.0        # 初始速度
    BULLET_LIFETIME = 3.0        # 生命周期（秒）
    BULLET_DAMAGE = 10.0         # 伤害值
    BULLET_SCALE_XY = 0.05      # 子弹粗细
    BULLET_SCALE_Z = 0.5        # 子弹长度
    
    def __init_pyobj__(self):
        """初始化 Python 变量"""
        self.projectile_movement = None
        self.bullet_mesh = None
        self.spawn_time = 0.0
    
    @ue.ufunction(override=True)
    def ReceiveBeginPlay(self):
        """Actor 开始播放时调用"""
        ue.Log(f"Bullet '{self}' ReceiveBeginPlay")
        
        # 记录生成时间
        self.spawn_time = self.GetGameTimeSinceCreation()
        
        # 添加视觉表现
        self._setup_visual()
        
        # 设置投射移动组件
        self._setup_projectile_movement()
        
        # 绑定 Actor 级别的碰撞事件
        self.OnActorHit.Add(self._on_actor_hit)
    
    def _setup_visual(self):
        """设置视觉表现（静态网格）"""
        # 创建静态网格组件
        self.bullet_mesh = ue.NewObject(
            ue.StaticMeshComponent,
            self,
            "BulletMesh"
        )
        self.bullet_mesh.RegisterComponent()
        
        # 加载引擎自带的圆柱体网格
        cylinder_mesh = ue.LoadObject(ue.StaticMesh, "/Engine/BasicShapes/Cylinder.Cylinder")
        if cylinder_mesh:
            self.bullet_mesh.SetStaticMesh(cylinder_mesh)
        
        # 设置缩放（细长圆柱）
        self.bullet_mesh.SetWorldScale3D(ue.Vector(
            self.BULLET_SCALE_XY,
            self.BULLET_SCALE_XY,
            self.BULLET_SCALE_Z
        ))
        
        # 附加到根组件（如果有的话）
        root = self.GetRootComponent()
        if root:
            self.bullet_mesh.AttachToComponent(
                root,
                ue.Name("None"),
                ue.EAttachmentRule.KeepRelative,
                ue.EAttachmentRule.KeepRelative,
                ue.EAttachmentRule.KeepRelative,
                False
            )
        else:
            # 如果没有根组件，设置为根组件
            self.bullet_mesh.SetupAttachment(None)
        
        ue.Log("Bullet: Visual setup complete")
    
    def _setup_projectile_movement(self):
        """设置投射移动组件"""
        # 查找现有的 ProjectileMovementComponent
        self.projectile_movement = self.GetComponentByClass(ue.ProjectileMovementComponent)
        
        if not self.projectile_movement:
            # 创建新的投射移动组件
            self.projectile_movement = ue.NewObject(
                ue.ProjectileMovementComponent,
                self,
                "ProjectileMovement"
            )
            self.projectile_movement.RegisterComponent()
        
        # 配置投射参数
        self.projectile_movement.InitialSpeed = self.BULLET_SPEED
        self.projectile_movement.MaxSpeed = self.BULLET_SPEED
        self.projectile_movement.bRotationFollowsVelocity = True
        self.projectile_movement.bShouldBounce = False
        
        # 根据 Actor 旋转设置初始速度方向
        actor_rotation = self.GetActorRotation()
        forward = ue.KismetMathLibrary.GetForwardVector(actor_rotation)
        self.projectile_movement.Velocity = forward * self.BULLET_SPEED
    
    def _on_actor_hit(self, self_actor, other_actor, normal_impulse, hit_result):
        """
        Actor 碰撞回调
        
        Args:
            self_actor: 自己
            other_actor: 碰撞到的 Actor
            normal_impulse: 冲击力
            hit_result: 命中结果
        """
        # 忽略碰撞到空（比如刚刚发射时的空气）
        if not other_actor:
            return
        
        ue.Log(f"Bullet hit: {other_actor}")
        
        # 这里可以添加伤害逻辑
        # if other_actor and hasattr(other_actor, 'take_damage'):
        #     other_actor.take_damage(self.BULLET_DAMAGE)
        
        # 销毁子弹
        self.Destroy()
    
    @ue.ufunction(override=True)
    def ReceiveTick(self, delta_time: float):
        """每帧更新"""
        # 检查生命周期
        current_time = self.GetGameTimeSinceCreation()
        if current_time - self.spawn_time > self.BULLET_LIFETIME:
            ue.Log(f"Bullet lifetime expired, destroying")
            self.Destroy()
    
    @ue.ufunction(override=True)
    def ReceiveEndPlay(self, end_play_reason):
        """Actor 结束播放时调用"""
        ue.Log(f"Bullet '{self}' ReceiveEndPlay")

# -*- encoding: utf-8 -*-
"""射击组件"""

import ue


class ShootingComponent:
    """处理射击逻辑"""
    
    DEFAULT_FIRE_RATE = 0.1  # 射击间隔（秒）
    MUZZLE_OFFSET_FORWARD = 100.0   # 枪口前方偏移
    MUZZLE_OFFSET_UP = 50.0         # 枪口高度偏移
    MUZZLE_OFFSET_RIGHT = 30.0      # 枪口右侧偏移（越肩）
    
    def __init__(self, owner):
        """
        初始化射击组件
        
        Args:
            owner: 角色实例 (ue.Character)
        """
        self.owner = owner
        self.bullet_class = None
        self.fire_rate = self.DEFAULT_FIRE_RATE
        self.last_fire_time = -999.0
        
        # 连发射击状态
        self._is_firing = False
    
    def set_bullet_class(self, bullet_class):
        """
        设置子弹类
        
        Args:
            bullet_class: 子弹 Actor 类
        """
        self.bullet_class = bullet_class
        ue.Log(f"ShootingComponent: Bullet class set to: {bullet_class}")
    
    def _get_current_time(self) -> float:
        """获取当前游戏时间"""
        return self.owner.GetGameTimeSinceCreation()
    
    def can_shoot(self) -> bool:
        """检查是否可以射击"""
        if not self.bullet_class:
            ue.LogWarning("ShootingComponent: No bullet class set!")
            return False
        
        current_time = self._get_current_time()
        return (current_time - self.last_fire_time) >= self.fire_rate
    
    def start_firing(self):
        """开始射击（按住鼠标左键）"""
        self._is_firing = True
        ue.Log("ShootingComponent: Start firing")
        
        # 立即发射第一颗子弹
        self.shoot()
    
    def stop_firing(self):
        """停止射击（松开鼠标左键）"""
        self._is_firing = False
        ue.Log("ShootingComponent: Stop firing")
    
    def tick(self, delta_time: float):
        """
        每帧更新（用于连发射击）
        
        Args:
            delta_time: 帧间隔时间
        """
        if self._is_firing:
            self.shoot()
    
    def shoot(self):
        """执行射击"""
        if not self.can_shoot():
            return False
        
        controller = self.owner.GetController()
        if not controller:
            ue.LogWarning("ShootingComponent: No controller!")
            return False
        
        # 根据瞄准状态选择射击方向（混合模式）
        # - 腰射：用角色朝向
        # - 开镜：用摄像机方向（精确瞄准）
        is_aiming = False
        if hasattr(self.owner, 'camera') and self.owner.camera:
            is_aiming = self.owner.camera.is_aiming()
        
        if is_aiming:
            # 开镜：使用摄像机方向
            fire_rotation = controller.GetControlRotation()
        else:
            # 腰射：使用角色朝向
            fire_rotation = self.owner.GetActorRotation()
        
        # 获取角色位置
        actor_location = self.owner.GetActorLocation()
        
        # 计算枪口位置
        forward = ue.KismetMathLibrary.GetForwardVector(fire_rotation)
        right = ue.KismetMathLibrary.GetRightVector(fire_rotation)
        up = ue.KismetMathLibrary.GetUpVector(fire_rotation)
        
        spawn_location = (
            actor_location 
            + forward * self.MUZZLE_OFFSET_FORWARD
            + right * self.MUZZLE_OFFSET_RIGHT
            + up * self.MUZZLE_OFFSET_UP
        )
        
        # 生成子弹
        world = self.owner.GetWorld()
        bullet = world.SpawnActor(
            self.bullet_class,
            spawn_location,
            fire_rotation
        )
        
        if bullet:
            self.last_fire_time = self._get_current_time()
            ue.Log(f"ShootingComponent: Shot fired (aiming={is_aiming})")
            return True
        else:
            ue.LogWarning("ShootingComponent: Failed to spawn bullet!")
            return False
    
    def is_firing(self) -> bool:
        """检查是否正在射击"""
        return self._is_firing

messages.content:
看到了，你当前的状态机很简单：

```
Entry → idle ↔ movement
```

只有两个状态，没有跳跃。

## 建议加法

最简洁的方式是在状态机里加一个 `jump` 状态，通过 `bIsInAir` 变量切换：

```
                 ┌──────────────────────────┐
                 │                          ↓
Entry → idle ↔ movement ←─→ jump
                 │              ↑   ↑
                 └──────────────┘   │
                 (落地回到idle/movement)
```

具体过渡规则：

| 过渡 | 条件 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| idle → movement | Speed > 10 | 开始移动 |
| movement → idle | Speed < 10 | 停止移动 |
| idle → jump | bIsInAir == True | 起跳 |
| movement → jump | bIsInAir == True | 跑步中起跳 |
| jump → idle | bIsInAir == False | 落地回到待机 |
| jump → movement | bIsInAir == False && Speed > 10 | 落地时还在移动 |

`bIsInAir` 变量需要在 Event Graph 里每帧从 `CharacterMovement.IsFalling()` 获取，和 `velocity`/`Direction` 的计算方式一样。

## 需要做的事

1. **Event Graph** — 新增 `bIsInAir`（Boolean）变量，每帧从 Pawn 的 `CharacterMovement.IsFalling()` 赋值
2. **状态机** — 新增 `jump` 状态，内部放跳跃动画（`MM_Rifle_Jump_Start` → `MM_Rifle_Jump_Fall_Loop`，或者简单点只放一个 `MM_Rifle_Jump_Fall_Loop`）
3. **过渡规则** — 按上表添加 4 条过渡

你想先在编辑器里手动做，还是我帮你在 Python 端把 `bIsInAir` 变量的计算加上？
你可以在python中帮我算好bIsInAir吗，然后我在动画蓝图中能拿到这个变量吗

可以。Python 算好 `bIsInAir`，然后在动画蓝图里通过 `GetAnimInstance().SetBoolParameter()` 传递。

但更直接的方式是：**动画蓝图自己算 `bIsInAir`**，不经过 Python。你的 Event Graph 里已经有 `Try Get Pawn Owner` → `Get Velocity` 的逻辑，再加一个 `Is Falling` 判断就行，和 Python 完全解耦。

不过你要在 Python 里算也行，我帮你加。两种方案的对比：

| 方案 | 数据流 | 优点 | 缺点 |
|------|--------|------|------|
| **A. 动画蓝图自己算** | Event Graph → bIsInAir 变量 | 简单直接，不依赖 Python tick | 你需要在编辑器里手动加节点 |
| **B. Python 算完传过去** | Python tick → SetBoolParameter → 动画蓝图 | 不用动编辑器 | 每帧多一次跨语言调用，有延迟风险 |

我建议**方案 A**，你在 Event Graph 里加这几个节点就行：

```
Try Get Pawn Owner
    → Get Character Movement (如果NePy没暴露这个属性，用IsFalling可能不行)
    → Is Falling
    → SET bIsInAir
```

但考虑到你用的是 NePy，`CharacterMovement` 的访问可能有限制。要不要我先在 Python 端把 `bIsInAir` 算好，你在动画蓝图里新建同名变量，我在 `base_character.py` 的 `ReceiveTick` 里每帧同步过去？
怎么在蓝图中算是否在空中，只要velocity中的z不为0吗

不够准确。`Velocity.Z != 0` 的问题：

- 走上斜坡时 Z ≠ 0，但角色在地上
- 起跳瞬间和落地瞬间都有 Z 值，但状态不同

正确做法是判断 **CharacterMovementComponent.IsFalling()**：

| 情况 | Velocity.Z | IsFalling() | 实际状态 |
|------|-----------|-------------|---------|
| 平地走 | 0 | False | 在地面 ✅ |
| 上斜坡 | ≠ 0 | False | 在地面 ✅ |
| 跳跃上升 | > 0 | True | 在空中 ✅ |
| 下落 | < 0 | True | 在空中 ✅ |

messages.content:
你实际有 6 个跳跃动画，不是 4 个。标准做法是：

## 状态机结构

在 `GroundLocomotion` 状态机里加一个 `jump` 状态，但 `jump` 内部再套一个**子状态机**：

```
jump (子状态机)
  Entry → JumpStart → JumpLoop → JumpLand
                 ↑         ↓
                 └─循环───┘
```

| 子状态 | 用哪个动画 | 说明 |
|--------|-----------|------|
| `JumpStart` | `MM_Rifle_Jump_Start` | 起跳，播放一次后自动进 JumpLoop |
| `JumpLoop` | `MM_Rifle_Jump_Fall_Loop` | 上升+下降循环播放，直到落地 |
| `JumpLand` | `MM_Rifle_Jump_Fall_Land` | 落地动作，播完回到主状态机 |

## 过渡规则

**主状态机（GroundLocomotion）：**

| 过渡 | 条件 |
|------|------|
| idle → jump | `bIsInAir == True` |
| movement → jump | `bIsInAir == True` |
| jump → idle | `bIsInAir == False && Speed < 10` |
| jump → movement | `bIsInAir == False && Speed >= 10` |

**jump 子状态机内部：**

| 过渡 | 条件 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| JumpStart → JumpLoop | 剩余时间 ≤ 0（自动） | 起跳动画播完 |
| JumpLoop → JumpLoop | 无（自循环） | 循环播放下落 |
| JumpLoop → JumpLand | `bIsInAir == False` | 检测到落地 |

## 不用的动画

- `MM_Rifle_Jump_Apex` — 到达最高点的过渡动画，可选，不加也行
- `MM_Rifle_Jump_Start_Loop` — 起跳+循环合并版，你已经有分开的版本了
- `MM_Rifle_Jump_RecoveryAdditive` — 落地恢复的叠加动画，当前不需要

## 操作步骤

1. 在 `GroundLocomotion` 状态机里新建 `jump` 状态
2. 双击进入 `jump`，右键选 **Add State Machine**，命名为 `JumpSM`
3. 在 `JumpSM` 里按上面表格建 3 个状态和过渡
4. 回到 `GroundLocomotion`，连好 idle/movement ↔ jump 的 4 条过渡
在状态机中怎么判断JumpStart动画做完了呢

双击 `JumpStart` → `JumpLoop` 的过渡箭头，在规则里加一个节点：

```
Time Remaining (ratio) ← 从 JumpStart 动画节点拖出来搜索
    → <= 0.05  （留一点余量，不要用0）
    → 连到 Can Enter Transition
```

或者更简单的方式：**不写任何规则，留空**。

留空 = 过渡条件为 `True`，但 UE 的状态机有个默认行为：**当前状态的动画必须播放至少一帧才会检查过渡**。所以 JumpStart 动画会完整播放一次（因为它不是循环的），播完后时间线到末尾，下一帧过渡自动触发进入 JumpLoop。

两种都行，留空最简单。
好像留空会过度不过去

那用 `Time Remaining` 节点。在过渡规则里：

```
Get Time Remaining (ratio)
    → <= 0.05
    → Can Enter Transition
```

具体操作：

1. 双击 `JumpStart` → `JumpLoop` 的过渡箭头
2. 右键搜索 `Time Remaining`，选 **Get Time Remaining (ratio)**
3. 拖出输出引脚，搜索 `<=`，输入 `0.05`
4. 把 `<=` 的结果连到 **Can Enter Transition** 节点

这样 JumpStart 播到剩余不足 5% 时就会过渡到 JumpLoop。

Quinn 既是骨骼也是 Mesh，它们是绑在一起的：

| 概念 | 你的项目里 | 说明 |
|------|-----------|------|
| **骨骼** | `SK_Quinn`（在 SKM_Quinn_Simple 内部） | 骨骼层级结构 |
| **Mesh** | `SKM_Quinn_Simple` | 骨骼 + 蒙皮网格 |

## MM 动画能不能直接用？

**可以直接用，不需要重定向。** 原因：

- MM 动画（`MM_Rifle_Fire`、`MM_Rifle_Equip` 等）是 Root Motion 动画，它们绑定的骨骼就是 Quinn 的骨骼
- 你现在角色用的就是 Quinn 骨骼，所以 MM 和 MF 动画**都能直接用**

## 什么时候需要重定向？

只有当你**换骨骼**的时候才需要：

| 情况 | 需要重定向？ |
|------|-------------|
| Quinn 骨骼 + Quinn 的 MM/MF 动画 | ❌ 不需要 |
| 换成 Manny 骨骼 + Quinn 的 MF 动画 | ✅ 需要（A-Pose → T-Pose 差异） |
| 换成 Manny 骨骼 + Quinn 的 MM 动画 | ✅ 需要 |

**总结：你现在的 Quinn 骨骼 + 所有 MM/MF 动画都兼容，放心用。**

Analyzes images, videos, and audio files using a multimodal model. This tool accepts local file paths, base64 data, or URLs to multimedia content. Supported formats include common image types (PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP, BMP), video formats (MP4, MKV, OGG), and audio formats (MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, M4A).

• Visual Agent: Operates PC/mobile GUIs, recognizes UI elements, understands functions, can guide through interface interactions
• Visual Coding: Generates Draw.io diagrams, HTML/CSS/JS code from images/videos
• Text Extraction: Reads and extracts all text from images including documents, receipts, screenshots
• Spatial Perception: Judges object positions, viewpoints, occlusions, provides 2D grounding
• Content Analysis: Describes scenes, identifies objects, analyzes actions in videos
• Audio Understanding: Transcribes speech, identifies sounds, analyzes audio content
• Technical Understanding: Interprets charts, diagrams, technical drawings, code screenshots

The model responds based on your specific prompt. Examples: 'Extract all text from this receipt', 'Generate HTML code for this UI design', 'Identify all clickable elements in this screenshot', 'Describe the spatial relationships between objects', 'Transcribe the speech in this audio', 'What sounds are in this recording?'.

它们的关系：

```
SK_Mannequin (骨骼)
    ├── SKM_Manny_Simple (骨骼网格体) — 男性皮肤
    └── SKM_Quinn_Simple (骨骼网格体) — 女性皮肤
```

| 资产 | 类型 | 作用 |
|------|------|------|
| `SK_Mannequin` | **骨骼（Skeleton）** | 定义骨骼层级结构，是"骨架" |
| `SKM_Manny_Simple` | **骨骼网格体（Skeletal Mesh）** | 男性外观 + 引用上面的骨骼 |
| `SKM_Quinn_Simple` | **骨骼网格体（Skeletal Mesh）** | 女性外观 + 引用上面的骨骼 |

**关键点：Manny 和 Quinn 共享同一套骨骼 `SK_Mannequin`**，只是默认姿态不同（Manny 是 T-Pose，Quinn 是 A-Pose）。

所以：
- 所有基于 `SK_Mannequin` 骨骼的动画，Manny 和 Quinn **都能用**
- 你现在用 Quinn，MM/MF 动画都是这个骨骼的，直接兼容
- 如果换成 Manny，动画也是同一套骨骼，只是 Quinn 的 MF 动画需要重定向处理 A-Pose → T-Pose 的差异
